description: This file defines the 'PopupQuickCreate' class, which extends another class to implement a quick create form within a popup window for a CRM system, specifically SuiteCRM. It includes constructor logic for setting default behaviors and a method to process the form rendering.

classes.name: PopupQuickCreate
classes.description: A class that facilitates quick creation of records via a popup window in SuiteCRM, extending the 'SubpanelQuickCreate' class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PopupQuickCreate object, setting default processing flag and defining form buttons.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles form processing and display for the quick create popup.
